description: SEC 10-K cybersecurity governance (Item 1C) — Pull Item 1C (Cybersecurity) from a US public company's latest (or earlier, filing=0-4) Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR and structure it: named security frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS...), security leader roles (CISO, CIO, CSO) and stated years of experience, board oversight (which committee, reporting frequency, the oversight sentence), practices (incident response plan, penetration testing, tabletop exercises, vendor risk, external assessors, SOC, threat intel...), whether a material cybersecurity incident is disclosed plus the company's own statement, a disclosure-detail score 0-100 with tier DETAILED/STANDARD/MINIMAL (CROSS_REFERENCED when Item 1C only points elsewhere), disclosure gaps and an excerpt. Use it for vendor security due diligence, third-party risk reviews and peer benchmarking. ticker: stock ticker or CIK (e.g. KO). filing: optional, 0 = latest 10-K (default) up to 4. The score measures how detailed the disclosure is, not how secure the company is. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
